```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(htmltools)
library(googlesheets4)

using_googlesheets         <- TRUE
positions_sheet_loc        <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kzVjmxlzmNsFXYa_A9A6OpZcMWZC1zOY62Ra5Xd9OPE/edit?usp=sharing"
sheet_is_publicly_readable <- TRUE
PDF_EXPORT                 <- FALSE
links                      <- c()

source("gather_data.R")
source("R/cv_functions.R")

resume_data <- position_data %>%
  filter(in_resume == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(section = case_when(
    section %in% c("research_experience", "professional_experience") ~ "positions",
    section %in% c("invited_talks", "academic_articles")             ~ "featured",
    TRUE ~ section
  ))
```

<div class="sidebar-section">
<div class="sidebar-section-head">Contact</div>

```{r contact}
contacts <- list(
  list(icon = "mail",     label = "jpflores013@gmail.com",   href = "mailto:jpflores013@gmail.com"),
  list(icon = "github",   label = "github.com/jpflores-13",   href = "https://github.com/jpflores-13"),
  list(icon = "link",     label = "jpflores.rbind.io",        href = "https://jpflores.rbind.io"),
  list(icon = "linkedin", label = "in/john-patrick-flores",   href = "https://linkedin.com/in/john-patrick-flores"),
  list(icon = "bluesky",  label = "@jpflores.rbind.io",       href = "https://bsky.app/profile/jpflores.rbind.io")
)
items <- sapply(contacts, function(c) {
  paste0("<li>", lucide_icon(c$icon), ' <a href="', c$href, '">', c$label, "</a></li>")
})
HTML(paste0('<ul class="contact-list">', paste(items, collapse = "\n"), "</ul>"))
```

<div class="sidebar-section">
<div class="sidebar-section-head">Awards & Accolades</div>

```{r awards}
if (exists("resume_awards") && nrow(resume_awards) > 0) {
  award_rows <- resume_awards %>% filter(section == "awards")
  desc_cols  <- grep("^description_", names(award_rows), value = TRUE)
  bullets    <- unlist(award_rows[desc_cols])
  bullets    <- bullets[!is.na(bullets) & nzchar(trimws(bullets))]
  items      <- paste0("<li>", sapply(bullets, render_md), "</li>", collapse = "\n")
  HTML(paste0('<ul class="awards-list">', items, "</ul>"))
}
```
